reports-form-legend: Legend/title of the report parameters form
reports-field-ignoreusers: Form field for selecting users to ignore
reports-field-ignoreusers-help: Help text for the ignore users field
reports-field-debug: Form checkbox to enable debug/editor-details mode
reports-field-debug-help: Help text for the debug checkbox
reports-number-of-articles-updated: Result message showing the count of updated articles. $1 is the number of articles.
reports-debug-editor-details: Heading for the debug section showing editor details
reports-distinct-users: Label for the distinct user count in debug mode
reports-people-and-bots: Summary of human and bot editors. $1 = number of human editors, $2 = number of bots.
reports-names: Label before the list of editor names
